_pinned_recipe._note: Qwen-Image-2512 is the GENERATOR. FLUX.2 klein base 4B remains the TRAINING base — two separate decisions. Qwen supports negative prompts, which the register discipline depends on; Flux.2 ignores them entirely.

_law.vary: setting, pose, action, framing, weather, time of day
_law.hold_constant: the lighting law — low-key, deep shadow side, a DEFINED lighting environment in every frame (never a void backdrop, per LIT-002), warm sodium as the world's light, cold cyan only as cyclops emission
_law.why: A style LoRA learns the rendering law. Varying the world while holding the light teaches the model that the LAW is the style and the setting is incidental. Varying both teaches nothing.
_law.captions: NONE of this prompt vocabulary goes into a training caption. Captions are content-only prose, trigger-first. The strip pass is mandatory — see canon/ferrochrome-art-contract.md Caption law.
